notes.title: Update: Fix for CPU crash
notes.content:
Update: 01072024.1

Hello everyone,
This is update comes to you from Outer Heaven, where we've partnered with Signal Studios on Ascend: Reborn and future projects. Though it has been a long time since Toy Soldiers: Complete got an update, we had an opportunity to fix the CPU crash which has been a problem from the beginning. So we did!

This fix will work for the vast majority of CPUs, though the game will still be unable to run on CPUs with extremely high core counts.

We hope that this helps even more people enjoy the classic game Toy Soldiers: Complete, which includes both Toy Soldiers: Cold War, and Toy Soldiers 1 rebuilt with Cold War gameplay, along with all the DLC for those games.

Sincerely, 
Robin, Outer Heaven Studios

notes.title: Game Update 19 is now live!
notes.content:
Get ready for a new logo, balance updates, and bug fixes for Toy Soldiers: Complete! With this patch, it is recommended that you delete your previous local content before installing the game to help prevent legacy issues.

[h1] New Features & Patches Notes: [/h1]
-	There is a new logo and art for Toy Soldiers: Complete! As you may have noticed in the Steam store, the logo art has been updated! You will now see these changes in the game as well.
-	Multiple items have had a balance pass:
•	All Anti-Air turrets had balance updates.
•	German Anti-Tank turrets had damage adjustments for gameplay balance.
•	Hero damage had a balance change.

[h1] Bug Fixes: [/h1]
-	Two multiplayer desyncs have been fixed.
-	Two random memory crashes have been fixed.

[h1] Moderator Promotion [/h1]
[b] The_Pastmaster [/b] is the first and best source for answers within these forums. He has been a huge help during the Early Access process and was promoted to a Moderator for his efforts. Make sure to give him a high five if you see him in your thread!

[h1] Next Up: [/h1]
[b] Launching out of Early Access! [/b] The time has come: this [b] Wednesday, February 17, 2016 [/b] the game will go live. Watching this game change over 19 updates has been a fun trip with all of you fine community soldiers!

[b] What does leaving Early Access mean for the game? [/b] The community will be growing! There will be new faces to challenge in multiplayer! Fresh recruits for online co-op! These players will be installing the released, clean game and reporting new (if any) bugs with no legacy file issues.  This will help us discover any remaining issues within the game.

A number of issues in the forums will be moved to an Early Access sub-forum to keep your threads alive as new players join us.

As always, it has been an absolute pleasure working on this game with you soldiers before, during and after this Early Access timeline. As always, please feel free to reach out to me for answers to any issues that aren’t addressed in the forums.

[b] See you on the battlefield soldiers! [/b]

Best,
Logan

notes.title: Update 18 is now live!
notes.content:
Here is the run down for this patch.

•	The “Brass Hat” Achievement is now obtainable
•	Fixed the loading crash on the level, “Capital Crisis”
•	Fixed an issue with German AA turrets not needing to reload
•	Fixed several issues with the zeppelin boss including the boss disappearing on the German campaign
•	Rebalanced AA Turrets for both WWI Factions
•	Alt-tab crash fixes
•	Minor tweaks to memory to help prevent crashes on load ins
• Localization fixes and updates
•	Other issues addressed with missing art and overlapping text

For best results and to avoid common issues, please reset your progress completely.
Instructions for resetting your progress:

1)	Go into Steam> Settings> Cloud> Check off “Enable Steam Cloud synchronization for applications which support it”
2)	Set Steam to “Offline Mode” (Steam>Offline)
3)	Next Delete your local save folder which is “262120” (C:>Program Files>Steam>userdata>”Steam ID Number”>262120)
4)	Launch “Toy Soldiers: Complete”
5)	Proceed into any level then exit to create a Local save file
6)	Exit the game
7)	Set Steam to “Online Mode”
8)	Go into Steam>Settings>Cloud>Check on “Enable Steam Cloud synchronization for applications which support it”
9)	Launch “Toy Soldiers: Complete”
10)	A window will pop up saying there is a cloud sync conflict. Click on “Upload to the Steam Cloud”

Done! Your progress will now be completely reset.

Thank you all for the posts and those who have pinged me to make sure this game is as solid as possible as it approaches the end of Early Access. We couldn't have done it without each and every last person who used this to improve the development of this title. 

Please keep the info coming and please note that the end of Early Access does not mean the end of work on the game. We will continue to update that title as more issues with fresh information and repro steps are provided.

Any bugs or concerns/issues you come across, please post those on the forums. Any information you can provide is extremely helpful.

As always, you can send me questions on the forums or PM me when I’m available.

Best, 
Logan

notes.title: Game Update #17 is now Live!
notes.content:
[img]http://www.signalstudios.net/images/uploads/Game_Update.jpg[/img]


[h1][b]Included in this Update:[/b][/h1]
[list][*]The Zeppelin boss that has plagued us and all of you with issues is fixed!
[*]General launch crashes have been addressed.
[*]Boss intro music for TS1 has been updated.
[*]More desyncs in Multiplayer have been caught and resolved.
[*]Minor tweaks, audio fixes and other issues addressed.[/list]

 
[h1]A Message From Toy Soldiers Producer, Logan:[/h1]
[quote=Signal @XShadowStormX]

It has been a long time since our last update as Signal was focused on shipping Toy Soldiers: War Chest. Thank you all for your patience and helpful repro bugs which made it possible for us to move right over into fix-it mode and ultimately has made this patch possible!

We are hopefully at the final patch or an update away from taking this beauty out of Early Access and moving it the big wide world to allow other players to join you well experienced soldiers on the multiplayer battlefront! 

Please make sure to continue to update us on the forums if you are still experiencing any issues so we can address them. 

If you need to, you can always send questions to me on the forums or poke me if you see me online and available. 

Best,
Logan[/quote]

 

[i]A finale note:[/i] 
If old issues creep up, give these steps a quick try first:
[list][*]Go to the Main Menu and select Help and Options.
[*]At the bottom of that menu select Reset Game Progress.
[*]Press Enter to Confirm.[/list]

notes.title: Patch Notes #13
notes.content:
This is the content complete update! This update finally adds the last two missing bosses: K-Wagen and Robo Bob! Along with all the single player campaign content being in the game, survival is also ready to accept your best defenses!


[h1][b]Here is a run down of all the items that have been added or fixed since the last update:[/b][/h1]

1) All missions included the boss for the The Kaiser's Battle DLC and Invasion! DLC are in the game!
2) UI is finished now. If you see any typo's or weird issues in other languages, please let us know!
3) Fixes have been added for decorations.
4) Toy Soldiers Survival mode is fixed and should be playable now. How many rounds can you survive?
5) Wave table fixes, AA aiming fixes, disconnect fixes and balance fixes are also in this patch!


[h1]So whats next?[/h1]
In the next weeks we will be finishing up a few bug fixes that we know are in some of the levels. We will be receiving our final audio pass, our final ratings certificate from the E.S.R.B. and of course responding and fixing any bugs that you happen to be kind enough to let us know about!

I know this update has been delayed but we wanted to make sure you could finally play all of the content that was in Toy Soldiers before we released it.

Thank you again for your support and your patience! If you find bugs, please report them [url=http://steamcommunity.com/app/262120/discussions/0/613948093874744213/]here:[/url]

notes.title: Patch Notes #10
notes.content:
Sorry the update has taken a bit longer than expected, but we're back with a HUGE update! Multiplayer, Kaiser's Battle DLC, British Campaign Bosses, and more has been added this week.

[u][h1] [b]Updates[/b] [/h1][/u]
[list][*]Multiplayer
[*] Toy Soldiers German Campaign added
[*] The Kaiser's Battle DLC added
[*] Toy Soldiers British Campaign Bosses added:
     - The Tsar Tank
     - The Zeppelin
     - The Uber Tank
[*] All WWI unites overhauled, fixed, and re-balanced
[*] New Player Units added to the Toy Soldiers Pilot Airships and Copters for the first time!
[*] Toy Soldiers APC's now deploy Elite Troops
[*] New WWI themed  Barrages added:
     - Bombing Run
     - Poison Gas Attack
     - Airship Support
     - TNT Blast
[*] New WWI "Special Forces" Barrages added:
     - Tommy: British Commando.
     - Fritz: German Kommando.
     - Lemmy: Forces de Special.
[*] [b]Brand new look![/b] New environmental lighting and effects across all games.
[*] New battlfield physics and pathing fixes for Toy Soldiers.
[*] Original Toy Soldiers sound effects are in the process of being ported over.
[*] New Decorations have been added to Toy Soldiers, including WWI-inspired medals
[*] New Toy Soldiers Complete logo, and additional GUI art fixes.
[/list]

[h1][b] [u]Known Issues:[/u][/b][/h1]

[u]General:[/u][list]
[*]Toy Soldiers sound effects buggy/not complete
[*] Toy Soldiers Survival Maps need to be implemented
[*] Still missing some text "loc string not found" issues
[*] Problem with French Flame Thrower Turret
[*] Problems with German Airships
[*] Possible crash on completing levels
[/list]


[u]British Campaign:[/u][list]
[*] British Final Boss missing
[*]British Bosses have a a few bugs (ex: floating object, boss can get stuck)
[*] Some medals have wrong Decorations
[*] Some Decorations may not work
[/list]

[u] German Campaign:[/u][list]
[*] German Bosses need to be implemented
[*] Some levels may have collision and/or pathing issues
[*] Some medals have wrong decorations
[*] Some Decorations may not work
[/list]

[u]DLC[/u][list]
[*] Invasion! DLC needs to be implemented
[*] Kasier's Battle DLC Boss needs to be implemented
[*] Kaiser's Battle DLC levels may have collision and/or pathing issues
[*] Some decorations may not work
[*] Missing decoration medals
[/list]

[u]Multiplayer:[/u][list]
[*]Multiplayer balancing issues
[*] Multiplayer wave lists issues (ex: some waves that are not currently being supported/added to game are being called into the game.)
[*] French Hero's weapon is offset
[*] No ready indicator
[*] Collision issues in some maps
[*] Problems with HUD information
[/list]

That's it for this week's update! If you did not receive the update, please restart Steam.

Thanks for your continued support and let us know if you run into any issues in the forums! 

http://steamcommunity.com/app/262120/discussions/0/613935404092015231/

notes.title: Patch #9 Notes!
notes.content:
Patch time! We've put in some major work this week with music, animations, and bug fixes!

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1][list]
[*]New music and sound effects have been placed in the game for TS1.
[*]Performed balance passes on TS1 units.
[*]All 12 British levels have had fly in camera animations and wave balances.
[*]First setup UI has been added for Multiplayer and British units will be playable in the next build! Time to see the might of multiplayer shortly!
[*]General bug fixes.[/list]

[h1]Known Problems:[/h1]
[*]The sniper towers cannot aim vertically.
[*]The British bombers secondary weapon fires off when the player hits "Left-click"
[*]Aircraft locks up and continues to move forward endlessly if the player boosts the aircraft to the edges of the maps.
[*]The mouse sensitivity on the aircraft is very low, which can make it difficult to turn.
[*]When the player attempts to roll in the British Bomber, the plane becomes stationary during the roll.
[*]The British Bomber cannot fire any weapons while the plane is in "Bomber Camera" mode.
[*]Map descriptions of 8-12 overlap "Press to Join" while selecting a campaign map in the British Campaign.
[*]Crash occurs pausing and then resuming the game on The Spring [*]Offensive, Hill Cote 304, Langemarcke 1917, and Polygon Wood levels.
[*]Multiplayer still desyncs.  :(
[/list]
Thank you all for your support :D We can't wait to get multiplayer working fully!

If you do not see the update, please restart Steam.

notes.title: Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #8
notes.content:
Hello Soldiers!
 
First of all, thank you so much for being patient while we work hard to update the game!
 
We'll be pushing a patch tonight with the following:
 
[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
All 1-12 levels in the British Campaign are now available in game! [b]We have a big week ahead of us as we work on audio, new bosses, and multiplayer for TS1 and TS2![/b]
 
[list][b]Here's the rest of the change notes:[/b]
[*]Updated unit pathing in British level 7 for all units.
[*]Addition of the anti-air crew animations.
[*]Fixed a user reported crash for medium tanks.
[*]Added in Zeppcopter animations.
[*]Most user reported issues in British level 9 have been addressed.
[*]Addition of animation for Train Boss.
[*]Improvements to the crewman animations for level 1 German turrets.
[*]Updates to weapon damage balance.
[*]Getting things ready for new TS1 barrages.
[*]Addition of animation for Zeppcopter with pilots.
[*]Animations for exit and take off for airships.

notes.title: Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #7
notes.content:
[img=http://www.signalstudios.net/images/uploads/News_Headers/news_banner_tscw.jpg]
Hey Soldiers! 
We apologize about the delay with this update, but we’ll be pushing the update today! Thank you all for your support during Early Access as it greatly helps us find issues in the game that need to be fixed!

[img=http://www.signalstudios.net/images/uploads/News_Headers/news_banner_tscw_01.jpg]

[h1]Patch Notes:[/h1]
Today, levels 1-7 of the original Toy Soldiers will go live! Also, Commando Barrages and artillery are in and working.

Feel free to jump in and play! Please note that there will still be some bugs/issues that we’d appreciate you reporting to us!

[b]Known Issues: [/b]
[list][*][b]DLCs[/b] - Currently all DLCs are locked as we finish perfecting them. 
[*][b]Achievements[/b] – Achievements are currently not earnable in TS1. 
[*][b]Display Case for TS1[/b] -There is no Display Case for the TS1 game currently. 
[*][b]Decorations[/b] - Currently the TS1 decorations section will be locked. 
[*][b]Fly-ins[/b] - The intro fly-in camera speeds are wrong due to the difference in how they are handled between TS1 and TSCW. Although the intro fly-in cameras work, there are no other intro cinematic elements in the levels yet. 
[*][b]Audio[/b] - Audio will probably take the longest as we’re converting the old TS1 audio from FMOD to WWYSE. However, this means that you’ll start hearing sounds that you haven’t heard before during gameplay. It will also help fix past performance issues that existed in the 360 and PC TS1 game. 
[*][b]Bosses[/b] – We’re reworking the bosses, so only the 1st one will be live with this patch. 
[*][b]Multiplayer[/b] - Multiplayer desync issues should slowly resolve themselves. They are caused by not having all the units in the game yet. As we add more and more of the units, this will be fixed. However, this current update does not push the TS1 units to multiplayer yet. 
[*][b]Leaderboards[/b] – All leaderboards for TS1 are in the process of getting hooked up. After they are all in and proved to be working with Early Access users, there will be a reset before the game goes live.[/list]

With continuing overall updates, stay tuned for UI changes, new features, and trading cards! 

Cheers!

[img=http://www.signalstudios.net/images/uploads/News_Headers/news_banner_ts_01.jpg]

notes.title: Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #6
notes.content:
Happy weekend everyone! 

In the next few hours you should be seeing update #6 for Toy Soldiers: Complete.

First, I want to let you all know that we’re looking to get some of the original Toy Soldiers content in the game very soon! Along with that, we’re working hard to get multiplayer working correctly. We all know you’re looking forward to both of those!

[*]Fixed the missing button icon on the profile badge "Press to Join" legend on the multiplayer screen

[*]Fixed helicopter HUDs using wrong control profile (planes instead of vehicles) for them displaying what keys to use
[*]Fixed keybindings using the wrong game control for Increase/Decrease altitude on vehicles – custom keybindings should work now!
[*]“Launch Wave” is now mapped to F key by default when using keyboard/mouse
[*]Artillery turret adjust view is now mouse wheel up/down when using keyboard/mouse[/list]

As always, thank you for your support during Early Access!

notes.title: Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #6
notes.content:
Hey Everyone!
I’d like to let you all know what we’ve been busy with this week at Signal Studios. Besides preparing for PAX, we’ve been working hard on Toy Soldiers: Complete.

Some bugs that we’re looking to have fixed for Friday:[list]
[*]Shadow ranges for low/med/high settings fixed (was not reading the ranges properly)
[*]Fixed missing button icon on the profile badge "Press to Join" legend.
[*]Added "<Button> Press to Join</button>" legend to the nav controls on level select and versus private match screens.
[*]Fixed helicopter HUDs using wrong control profile (planes instead of vehicles)
[*]Fixed keybindings using wrong game control for Increase/Decrease altitude on vehicles.[/list]

Besides that, we’re still working hard on the de-sync issue with Multiplayer. Unfortunately, this has been really challenging for us to fix, but we’re trying! We think it might be an issue with the syncing of the input, but need to dig deeper.

I also have some exciting news; the original Toy Soldiers content should open up soon in the game! It may still have some missing features, but we’re looking to at least get you all in the levels and playing!

Last, Trading Cards should also be implemented soon! We have special ones for the Early Access players, and different ones for after Early Access.

As always, we appreciate you’ve all supported us through this process! Early Access can be challenging, but we’re working very hard to make the game as awesome as it can be. We’re glad that you’re all helping us by reporting bugs and other problems! Thank you! ːDː

notes.title: Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #5
notes.content:
[h1]Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #5[/h1]
We've been working hard on Toy Soldiers: Complete with our pal's over at Krome Studios. 

Here's what we've put in today's build:
[list][b]UI Fixes:[/b]
[*]Tabbing out of the game while in the Weapons Case will no longer result is missing description text.
[*]When using the gamepad, cancelling a turret no longer leaves a transparent stamp of the turrets health bar on the map.
[*]Turret health meter no longer appears empty if the player tabs out of the game and then re-enters.[/list]
[list][b]Gameplay:[/b]
[*]Fixed a Tutorial Placement Menu bug that happened while playing at non-1280x720 resolution.
[*]Makeshift Turret III now says "(Hold) Fire" instead of just "Fire"
[*]MIRV secondary attack now works in Shell Cam while using an Artillery 2 unit.
[/list]
[list][b]Other:[/b]
[*]General icon and gameplay fixes.
[*]Potential fix for issues whereby the icons immediately swap to being keyboard/mouse icons, when using the controller
[*]Various fixes to help with startup crashes. 
[/list]
Along with these fixes, we're still working to get multi-player fixed and getting the original Toy Soldiers content live into the game. 
We thank you all for your support as we go through Early Access!

notes.title: Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #4
notes.content:
Hello! Once again, update time has come!
If you do not see the latest update, please restart your Steam client.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list][*]Added mouse wheel support for scrolling through various vertical menu options
[*]Versus mode “offensive wave list” popup menu can now be cancelled by right clicking the moue
[*]The sell turret confirmation dialog can now be cancelled by right clicking the moue
[*]When using keyboard and mouse, only the build sites that the mouse is hovering over is highlighted, not all build sites
[*]Steam Offline Mode should work properly now
[*]The “Brightness” control is disabled when running in a window (as it has no effect)
[*]The start of survival levels “Press <Enter> to skip” now works
[*]“Reset Profile” is now “Reset Game Progress” – settings (graphics, audio, controller) are not reset now, only the level progression
[*]Fixed an issue where the mouse cursor visibility would get out of sync with the restrict mouse cursor setting when returning to the title screen.
[*]Fixed an issue where input was disabled if the player accepted a game invite externally to the game (eg a Steam friend message window) while on the title screen. 
[*]The “Exit vehicle” text has been corrected
[*]Some changes to help with multiplayer desync (Unfortunately, there are still other issues).
[*]Fixed threading issue that may have been a cause of some peoples’ crashes trying to load the game.
[/list]
We're also still working hard to fix the original Toy Soldiers content for you to play! We'll make sure to keep you updated with that progress.

Once again, thank you for all your support while we work to fix all the issues in this game! We appreciate all your dedication!
Also, please continue to let us know what bugs you're experiencing!
Thanks :D

notes.title: Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #3
notes.content:
We've just pushed the third update to Toy Soldiers: Complete! Please close out of Steam and restart it in order to see these updates if it does not start automatically.

[b]Patch Notes:[/b]
[list]
[*]Hid the "Turn" hud icons on artillery turrets when in the Weapons Case (because the firing arc restriction on artillery turrets is removed in the Weapons Case).
[*]Fixed the missing sounds for the commandos in the Survival maps
[*]Fixed bug in splitscreen mode where positional audio would only use one player’s listener position
[*]Changed art to new keyboard icon set
[*]Mouse driven RTS cursor is now restricted to a camera blocker if one is enabled
[*]Fixed some barrages to get the real duration of a barrage instead of a hardcoded 20 seconds.
[*]Fixed permanent black screen after the end of game commando movie on the credits.
[*]Fixed an issue which may have been related to a crash on the frontend after returning from the end of game credits.
[*]Change to GUI texture formats so that it uses better texture filtering methods for if the display resolution is different to the source texture size. Improves quality of UI texture edges at higher resolutions (as it’s not longer just point sampling)
[*]Changes to make the single player game run at vsync framerate. Networked multiplayer still runs at 30fps fixed time delta. Misc fixes for hardcoded 30fps math that could affect gameplay. [list][b]This means that, in fullscreen:[/b]
[*]With VSync disabled, the game will run as fast as your PC can run the game
[*]With VSync set enabled the game will run at 60fps, if your PC can sustain 60fps. It will then drop to 45fps, 30fps, 20fps – or whatever your PC can sustain
[*]VSync has no effect if you’re running in a window, so it’ll just be rendering as fast as your PC can​.
[/list][/list]
Please let us know if you have any questions!

notes.title: Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #2
notes.content:
Our latest Toy Soldiers: Complete update is live! 
[list][b]Fixes in the current build:[/b]
[*]Improved mouse control for turrets and vehicles.
[*]Quick access keys working now (use, upgrade, repair, sell).
[*]Open Placement Menu icon in tutorial now bound to Left Mouse Button.
[*]Fixed incorrect button icon for "Drop_Bomb" in the bombing overlay.
[*]Replaced Out of Bounds Indicator "Press B to exit" text with a GameControlLegend and the text "to exit."
[*]Fixed lack of input control in split screen multiplayer when you pause or try to quit.
[*]When right click is held down, the mouse gets pinned to where you clicked so that the icon doesn't move on the screen. This stops the player from moving the mouse to the edge of the screen, and the game also starting to translate/pan at the same time as rotate.
[*]Changes to allow shell cam to use the same keys as the switch turrets so that shell caming while in an artillery turret (etc) doesn't change turrets if you try to speed up or slow down the shell.
[*]In keyboard and mouse mode, the build menu now only appears when clicking on a build site.
[*]Disabled circle cursor in keyboard and mouse mode.
[*]Added 'Report a Bug' option to the main menu that opens up to our Steam Discussion thread for reporting bugs.
[*]A simple method for resetting all key-bindings to default, using versioning in this place. This unfortunately means that people will lose all their current custom rebinds, sorry!
[/list]
[list][b]Still being worked on:[/b]
[*]Keyboard and mouse control updates.
[*]Network desync issues.
[*]Continuing work on Toy Soldiers 1!
[/list]
[b]EDIT: More notes to add![/b]
[list][*]Lots of mouse control/sensitivity fixes for all unit types
[*]Added in mouse invert options, separate to gamepad invert options
[*]Fixed some bugs on keyboard and mouse settings screen - Fixed the broken fade background & missing text entry
[*]Weapons Case - Navigation icons now display the correct controls for the mode you are in. Change turret, rotate turret and exit screen are shown when you're not in a turret. Exit turret is shown when you are in a turret.
[*]Weapons Case - Gamepad can now control the aiming of turrets in the Weapons Case. 
[*]Weapons Case - Changed the default binding of ENTER_EXIT_UNIT on gamepad to B so that the correct icon is shown on the nav icons. Disabled ENTER_EXIT_UNIT from actually triggering an enter unit when using gamepad, as that is handled by the SELECT when using gamepad. 
[*]SPACE (default binding) for quick enter/exit of turrets now works
[*]Mouse now moves to the first icon in turret selection menu automatically when you click on a build site
[*]Fixes so that Player 1 is Ivan in the Ironfisted Survival->Commando version. No idea how this could have worked on X360 as things were though, so not entirely sure this is the "correct" fix...? No sound in any of the survival maps for the commando ATM though.
[*]Misc fixes for some HUD elements not showing the correct controls.
[/list]
Let us know if you experience any bugs!

notes.title: Toy Soldiers: Complete Update #1
notes.content:
We made it through our first weekend on Steam, and we thank every single one of you for supporting us along the way!

We just released our first update to the game. The update fixes the following issues:
[list]
[*]The overlays for shellcam and similar parts being offset should be fixed for all resolutions
[*]The “UI is upside down and back the front” at high resolutions are fixed
[*]The game should now work on Window XP SP3
[*]16:9 aspect ratio letterboxing now works correctly when you change resolution in the game (rather than just working properly again once you reboot)
[*]16:9 aspect ratio letterboxing works correctly on the intro Signal Studios logo video
[*]The issue where you couldn't build turrets during some multiplayer games should be fixed
[*]A couple of small UI icon placement fixes on the main menu
[*]We’ve added a “game version” check to the networking
[/list]

Along with fixing bugs, we've been working hard on the inclusion of Toy Soldiers 1! We’re working on adding new Commandos, voices, and weapons that aren't seen in the original release. We’ll keep you all updated when we plan on releasing this, but we’re planning for it soon!

Again, thank you all for being so active on our Steam Discussions, along with our own [url=www.signalstudios.net/forums]forums[/url]. We appreciate all your support and feedback!
